findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - Drop a partially completed story after its first part merges and Forge cleans up the part branch.
The record scan checks only the story ref and surviving task branches. Task start creates a separate branch without advancing the approved story branch (`src/forge/task.py:268–283`), and normal merge cleanup deletes the remote and local task branches (`src/forge/merge.py:280–311`). The merged part record then exists on the default branch, which this scan omits. Removing the approval refusal therefore lets this story be dropped despite having a started part, hiding its remaining work from next and the board. Include the landed ref in the record check. The new test exercises only an unmerged part, so it passes despite this gap.
